name: Tamed Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a trace of order over a trace of chaos and lands where neither would alone.

name: Steadfast Guard
description: Hold a guard whose steady frame lets chaotic force swirl harmlessly round its edges.

name: Ordered Step
description: Step through a field of loose force along the one path that stays in order.

name: Fray Sense
description: Feel where chaos gathers and where order holds in the air round the user.

name: Pattern Snare
description: Throw a snare of ordered qi into a flailing mass of chaos and draw it taut around a foe.

name: Measured Surge
description: Pour a wild surge through the rigid channel of order and send it as one measured blow.

name: Fray Mend
description: Draw the frayed edges of a deviated flow back into order and clear the chaos from an ally.

name: Chaos Rein
description: Rein in a foe's chaotic technique with a firm line of order until it runs where the user wills.

name: Fixed Storm
description: Hold a storm of loose force to a fixed pattern and let it fall as a measured barrage on all in range.

name: Lawful Turmoil
description: Spread turmoil through a foe's technique by a rule of the user's own so that it undoes itself.

name: Chaos Bound
description: Bind a great mass of chaotic force into a net of order and close it on all foes within.

name: Pattern Tempest
description: streams: Order + Chaos; a tempest of wild force is shaped into a pattern and loosed as one ruled storm on foes.

name: Gap Palm
description: Strike a palm across a fixed interval so the blow lands as though the distance had been set to nothing.

name: Interval Guard
description: Hold a guard at a fixed span from the body and let no blow close that span.

name: Measured Gap
description: Cross a measured gap in one pace by fixing the distance in the mind as a law.

name: Fixed Distance
description: Fix the distance between the user and a foe so that neither can close or widen it.

name: Span Strike
description: Pierce across a set span in a straight stroke that reaches its target without crossing the space between.

name: Distance Seal
description: Seal a foe's reach so its technique cannot cross to the user from further than an arm.

name: Spatial Rule
description: Read the shape and size of a space by the laws that hold within it.

name: Span Lock
description: Lock a whole span of space so that no being or technique may pass through it.

name: Space Statute
description: Enforce the statute of place on a technique that tries to bend space and void its effect.

name: Dimensional Edict
description: Proclaim that no step may leap space within the range and nullify all that try.

name: Absolute Interval
description: streams: Order + Space; every distance in range is fixed by law so foes cannot close or flee and are struck.

name: Ordained Palm
description: Strike with a palm whose landing is written beforehand and cannot fall anywhere else.

name: Destined Guard
description: Raise a guard at the place where the blow was already fated to fall.

name: Decreed Step
description: Step to where the next moment will place the foe and be there before it arrives.

name: Fate Sense
description: Sense the settled course of a fight and where each blow is already bound to land.

name: Inevitable Grip
description: Close a grip on a foe that the course of events had already placed there.

name: Writ Strike
description: Strike where the foe's next step must carry it and meet it as it arrives.

name: Writ Mend
description: Write an ally's cleansed state into their course and strip a curse or taint from their qi.

name: Appointed Hour
description: Set the hour at which an ally's technique is bound to succeed and lend it the weight of that fate.

name: Fixed Fate
description: Fix a foe's next stroke into an outcome set by order so it can only fail.

name: Determined Blow
description: Deliver a blow whose result is decided before it leaves the hand and cannot be changed.

name: Destiny Ward
description: Hold a ward written to turn aside every blow that fate has not yet agreed to land.

name: Decreed Outcome
description: Decree the outcome of one exchange and bring it down on the chosen foe as fixed.

name: Foregone Verdict
description: streams: Order + Fate; the verdict is written before the blow so the foe is struck by what must be.

name: Written Ending
description: streams: Order + Fate; the end of a combat is written by the user and the foes then act it out.
